core_features: Set in or directly around an armed conflict (historical, near-future, or speculative)
Focus on soldiers, civilians, or leaders affected by war
Exploration of courage, trauma, camaraderie, and moral ambiguity
typical_conflicts: Survival in combat or under occupation
Protecting comrades or civilians under fire
protagonist_archetypes: Front-line soldier, medic, officer, resistance fighter
Civilian caught in the conflict with a crucial role
tone_guidelines: Serious, often grim; can include hope and solidarity but does not glorify war naively.

required_elements: At least one battle or direct experience of combat or its immediate aftermath
Visible effects of war on bodies, minds, or communities
Some moral or emotional cost to participation in the conflict
forbidden_elements: Purely glamorous, consequence-free depiction of war
